analyst_view.overall: Early view: Auxerre are 14th and lost 1-0 at home to Paris FC on 7 November, with a Cameron Archer goal ruled out and Kevin Trapp denying Archer later on. Toulouse are 12th and beat Strasbourg 3-1 on 6 November, with two goals coming from corners. I found little team news yet, so this rests mostly on form and is refreshed the day before kick-off.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. I lean slightly lower: Auxerre were held scoreless at home by Paris FC and their attack leans heavily on Archer, while two mid-to-lower sides with little separating them often produce a cagey game.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners. Toulouse won seven corners against Strasbourg and scored twice from set pieces, but one game is not enough to move off the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards. The Toulouse-Strasbourg game had plenty of fouls and a confrontation involving Tapé, but with no referee named yet I stay with the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 22.4 shots. Toulouse had only 10 shots against Strasbourg even while winning 3-1, which fits an efficient rather than high-volume side, so I lean a touch lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.9 shots on target. Toulouse put 5 of 10 on target in their last game, which offsets the lower shot volume, so I stay with the number.
